intro: That unstoppable arcade addiction is back, once you start, you can't stop! Ben and Carmen, two agents, join the fight! Blast zombie heads and take down the towering bosses closing in!
description:
A blood pumping, intense 2D side scrolling action game returns, more thrilling than ever! Simple yet deeply rewarding controls bring back the golden age of arcade gaming, now perfected. Facing an endless wave of zombies, keep pulling the trigger until your fingers ache. In a world drenched in blood, will you survive until the very end? Choose between Ben and Carmen, two agents with distinct personalities, and take on the stages your way. A loyal drone companion backs you up with special attacks, offering a glimmer of hope even in the most desperate moments.

・Choose Ben or Carmen and strategize your way through every stage
・A brand new ally arrives, your drone companion supports you with devastating special attacks
・Wipe out zombies with a wide arsenal including pistols, submachine guns, shotguns, and grenade launchers
・Discover hidden items scattered across each stage to boost your chances of survival
・Grow stronger with every stage cleared, making combat even more exhilarating
・Build your own strategy with diverse upgrades including weapon performance, health boosts, and expanded attack range
・Feel the rush of leveling up, again and again, without ever getting tired of it
・Land precise headshots on zombies for a satisfying, hard hitting sense of impact
・Face tougher enemies with every stage, putting your skills to the ultimate test

Heart pounding tension meets the sheer thrill of mowing down endless zombie hordes, a perfect combination of action waiting for you. Defeat countless zombies, overcome mighty bosses, and reach the final stage, where a shocking twist and an unforgettable ending await. Are you ready to witness the fate of Ben and Carmen on this deadly journey? Only you can survive this blood soaked world and uncover the truth. The feast of blood begins now, right at your fingertips.

Prologue
Anna, a former special forces soldier, once threw herself into a desperate battle against hordes of zombies to save the husband she loved. The world remembered her story, and peace seemed to have returned once more. But that peace did not last. A sinister green smoke rising above Dr Z's laboratory was the signal that a slumbering catastrophe had awakened once again.

Rushed to the scene, agent Ben and his partner Carmen entered the facility alongside a team in hazmat suits. But what greeted them were beings that had already turned into zombies. A summons signal from a secret agency crackled through the radio, and its emblem was, remarkably, the very same mark of the organization Anna had once faced. The two agents instantly sensed this was no coincidence, and that they now stood at the center of a conspiracy far greater than they had imagined.

Beyond the barricade stood the white haired, deranged scientist Dr Z, surrounded by a horde of zombies and wearing an unsettling grin. And looming behind him, a figure in a black hat with a hidden face hinted at an even darker force to come. Armed with nothing but their guns, their drone, and their trust in each other, Ben and Carmen step deeper into the zombie infested laboratory. The question left behind by Anne's Zombie Odyssey now rests in your hands to answer.
